_published_faq.name: How do I add Lnk.Bio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lnk.Bio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lnk.bio/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lnk.Bio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lnk.Bio lists 33 MCP tools, including get_profile, update_profile_pic, list_links, add_link, edit_link, delete_link, sort_links, list_groups, list_pages, add_page, edit_page, and delete_page.
